messages:
mike: Kicking off a two-wave deploy next Tue 02:00 UTC for api/runtime/console/router. Need pin/rollback callouts and owners. Deploybot will run it. Who's on runtime + router?

sara: @mike runtime here — I'll own wave1 (api + runtime). Recommend a 15m quiet window post-canary to watch metrics.

tim: Router oncall. I'll take wave2 with console. 15m sounds fine, but if we see routing latencies, we should extend to 20m.

mike: Proposed plan: wave1 = api+runtime (60% traffic), wave2 = router+console (40%). Rollback criteria: error rate >2% sustained over 5m OR p50 latency >500ms. Thoughts?

jen: +1. Add KV cache-miss spike as a rollback trigger — if miss rate >3x baseline we rollback.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: wave1 at 2027-07-22T02:00:00Z (1810300000), wave2 at 2027-07-22T02:30:00Z. Pins: api:v3.2.1, runtime:runtime-canary-07. Use `--pin` flag for manual deploys.

mike: Release notes live: https://redwood.example/release/2027-07-22 — schema changes called out (backwards compatible). Everyone add runbook notes for console<->runtime handshake.

sara: Health check snippet I'll use after wave1: `curl -sS https://api.stable/health | jq .status` -> expect: "ok". Will paste results here.

tim: If router header error rate increases I'll flip fallback route policy and pause wave2. How should we signal a pause? `:pause_wave2` in channel or just `@deploy-bot hold wave2`?

ops-bot: To pause: either comment `@deploy-bot hold wave2` in the thread or run `deployctl hold --wave 2`. Deploybot will auto-hold and post status. If rolling back, remember to unpin the problematic variant.

mike: I'll also create temp alerts: p50 latency + KV miss spike. Paging goes to oncall. Wave1 owners: sara + mike. Wave2 owners: tim + jen. If no objections I'll kick at scheduled times.

jen: No objections. :thumbsup: 

sara: Will post canary metrics (errors/p50/kv) to this thread after 10m and again at 20m.

deploy-bot: wave1 started: deploying api:v3.2.1 -> runtime-canary-07. Logs: `deployer: start -> ok`.

mike: Thanks — keep updates short. If we rollback, state the reason and the last known-good pin (e.g. api:v3.2.0).

sara: Canary metrics after 10m: errors 0.4% (baseline 0.3%), p50=210ms, kv-miss=1.1x baseline. All green from runtime side.

tim: Router observing slight header parse errors +1. I'll watch for trend. If it crosses threshold I'll call `@deploy-bot hold wave2` and switch to fallback route.

mike: Copy. I'll monitor alerts and be ready to invoke rollback if criteria met.

jen: Thanks everyone. I'll prep console rollback steps in the runbook and attach to release notes.

deploy-bot: wave1 complete -> steady. Next: wave2 scheduled at 2027-07-22T02:30:00Z.

mike: Great. Keep this thread for operational notes only — move side-discussion to #eng-runtime if needed.
